firm_data.firm_description: Russo PLLC is a boutique legal firm offering innovative solutions for global business needs. They provide strategic guidance and legal representation for domestic and international clients.
notable_facts: Offers custom teams hand-picked to meet specific client needs.
Engages in strategic planning with an elite network of professionals from various fields.
Committed to environmental sustainability and energy conservation.
technology_signals: Uses bamboo, reusable, scannable business cards in partnership with V1CE for sustainable networking.

email.subject: AI for Russo PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Martin,

Your approach to assembling custom teams hand-picked for specific client needs caught my attention, particularly given the complexity of cross-jurisdictional litigation. That model scales best when you have tools that reduce friction on document review and legal research.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on strategic planning and litigation support.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
